mechanism: Olanzapine is metabolized by CYP1A2 and CYP2D6; progesterone may inhibit CYP3A4 and potentially affect olanzapine metabolism, while both agents increase CNS depression and metabolic/weight gain risk.
action: Monitor for increased olanzapine side effects (sedation, metabolic changes); consider dose adjustment if clinically significant CNS depression occurs; counsel on additive sedation risk.
